gaps.sentence: There's no point ___ about it now.
She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: He told me ___ touch that switch.
We went out ___ it was raining heavily.
I couldn't ___ laughing at his accent.
I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.
